lines.text: Looks like we've got ourselves a mystery!
The bathroom door is locked? It must be... a locked room mystery!
A detective's intuition comes and goes in an instant.

Doing detective work with you always brings me great pleasure, Watson!
Let's do it again some time!
Hmm... Looking around, the only thing I can see is you, Watson!

I have to say, Watson...
It seems that our tastes are quite similar!
Watson? Watson! Where are you?

Hmm, it seems Watson has disappeared...
Time to put my sleuthing skills to the test.
Don't disturb me! I'm trying to make a deduction.
How long do I have to rummage through this stuff... Ah hah! Found something!
Where does a detective's intuition come from? Probably from... the Radio Tower??
Wherever there's an unsolved mystery, you can bet I'll be close by!
My power of deduction seems to have improved!
Thank you for all your support.
Heh heh, my intuition has become sharper.
I-is this a gift? Interesting.
This gift certainly has piqued my curiosity!
I'm ecstatic!
Is love something that can be deduced? What I mean is... Better not expose myself.
If only I could find my magnifying glass to peer inside your mind.
Do you feel the same way as I? Let me make some deductions.
Need my sleuthing skills?
Standing by.
Oops!! Um... Should I go in person?
The battle has begun!
I'll make it quick!
Sleuthing skills, activate!
I'll show you all what a Nikke detective can do!
Reloading!
Come on!
Hurry up!
Idea!
Heh heh heh! Eureka!
There's no case I can't crack!
Consider this case closed!
Gotcha!
That should be all of them, heh heh.
Uh.
Ah!
Ugh!
I should have checked harder...
Elementary, my dear Watson!
